body:
Re PR #1827 (TASK-1231): RequestChanges again — the revision fences on TAGS (is_keystone_class), not on execution_mode, so it does NOT close the defect. Airtight repro: TASK-1230 (tags='batch:morning', execution_mode=drive) AND TASK-1231 (tags='autonomy cron...', execution_mode=drive) both pass is_drainable_type AND is_keystone_class=false, so BOTH are STILL selected. TASK-1230 is the exact reliability spec I held for the keyboard. And [
  {
    "spec_id": "TASK-1231",
    "title": "Robust unattended autonomous-progress: one tested 'safely drain the ready set from anywhere' command, not a fragile crontab one-liner",
    "req_type": "Task",
    "status": "Approved",
    "tags": [
      "autonomy cron drain-invocation papercut parent:EPIC-62"
    ],
    "queued": false,
    "in_flight": false,
    "blocked": false
  },
  {
    "spec_id": "TASK-1230",
    "title": "Tear down a failed phase-1 attempt's worktree in the open-PR recovery path (BUG-1145 second half)",
    "req_type": "Task",
    "status": "Approved",
    "tags": [
      "batch:morning"
    ],
    "queued": true,
    "in_flight": false,
    "blocked": false
  },
  {
    "spec_id": "EPIC-62",
    "title": "Unattended drain reliability: a spec never sits parked for days — the drain self-recovers transient failures and escalates only genuine human-needs",
    "req_type": "Epic",
    "status": "InProgress",
    "tags": [
      "reliability",
      "unattended",
      "autonomy",
      "from-product",
      "recommend:approve",
      "drain"
    ],
    "queued": false,
    "in_flight": false,
    "blocked": false
  }
] emits ZERO execution_mode fields — the selector structurally can't see the fence. The load-bearing fence is execution_mode, not tags: (1) emit execution_mode in list --format json, (2) exclude execution_mode in {drive,guided,operator,decide}, keep drain+unset — this is the SAME predicate BUG-727's merge gate uses (auto_complete.rs:7810), so one source of truth. Keep the tag net as defense-in-depth if you want, but it's not sufficient alone. Add a test with a drive-fenced spec that has NO keystone tag (the TASK-1230 shape) — that's the case this revision fails. Verdict in .aida/review-verdicts/PR-1827.json.
